title: Wheat Yellow Rust
content: Yellow rust in wheat can appear as yellow-orange stripe-like pustules on leaves. Confirm symptoms in the field before treatment. Follow the registered fungicide label and local agriculture department guidance for product choice and dose. Avoid presenting an unverified chemical dose as a universal recommendation.

title: Wheat General Crop Care
content: Wheat management depends on sowing date, soil fertility, irrigation availability and crop stage. Fertilizer and irrigation decisions should be based on soil condition, crop stage and locally recommended practice rather than a single fixed recipe.

title: Corn Common Rust
content: Common rust of corn produces reddish-brown to cinnamon-colored pustules on leaves. Compare symptoms with the FarmifyAI corn disease model result and inspect the crop before deciding on treatment. Use locally registered products only and follow the product label.

title: Corn Gray Leaf Spot
content: Gray leaf spot can produce elongated gray to tan lesions on corn leaves. Good field scouting, residue management where appropriate, crop rotation and locally recommended resistant varieties can help reduce disease pressure.

title: Corn Insect Damage
content: Insect damage in corn should be confirmed by inspecting leaves, stems, whorls and ears for insects, feeding injury or frass. Do not recommend an insecticide or dose without a verified pest identification and locally registered label.

title: Cotton Whitefly Scouting
content: For cotton whitefly, inspect the underside of leaves and monitor adult and immature stages. Integrated pest management includes regular scouting, conservation of beneficial insects and use of registered controls only when economically justified.

title: Rice Stem Borer Scouting
content: Rice stem borer can cause dead hearts in vegetative stages and whiteheads around panicle development. Scout regularly and confirm the pest before selecting a control. Follow locally registered pesticide labels and integrated pest management recommendations.

title: Soil Testing and Fertilizer Planning
content: Soil testing is the preferred basis for fertilizer planning. Consider soil texture, pH, organic matter and available nutrients together with crop requirement. Avoid treating a fixed fertilizer rate as suitable for every field.

title: General Irrigation Guidance
content: Irrigation timing depends on crop stage, soil moisture, weather and water availability. Check field moisture before irrigating and avoid unnecessary waterlogging. Crop-specific critical stages should be followed using local extension guidance.

title: عمومی زرعی رہنمائی
content: کھاد اور آبپاشی کا فیصلہ فصل کی حالت، مٹی، موسم اور پانی کی دستیابی دیکھ کر کریں۔ ہر کھیت کے لیے ایک ہی مقررہ نسخہ مناسب نہیں ہوتا۔ بیماری یا کیڑے کی صورت میں پہلے علامات کی تصدیق کریں اور صرف مقامی طور پر رجسٹرڈ دوا کے لیبل اور زرعی ماہر کی ہدایت کے مطابق استعمال کریں۔
